dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute ischemic stroke in the vertebrobasilar territory (bilateral dorsomedial pontine and left thalamic perforator infarcts) due to intracranial atherosclerotic disease of the posterior cerebral artery, presenting as a vertical supranuclear gaze palsy (Parinaud-like syndrome)

ALTERNATIVES:
Vertebral artery dissection with artery-to-artery embolism to the basilar perforators
Cardioembolic stroke to the posterior circulation
Vertebrobasilar dolichoectasia with perforator compression/occlusion
